html:
A chieftain of the Cherusci, a Germanic people, who in 9 CE destroyed three Roman legions at the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest.

He knew Rome from the inside. As a young man he commanded Germanic troops in the Roman army, became a Roman citizen and was given equestrian rank. Back in Germany he served the governor Varus, who trusted him, while he secretly built an alliance of tribes. He told Varus of a revolt and led his army into an ambush in the forests and marshes. Three legions died.

Rome struck back. From 14 to 16 CE Germanicus led big campaigns across the Rhine and won battles, but Rome gave up trying to hold the land. Arminius then fought Maroboduus, king of the Marcomanni. In 21 CE he was murdered by his own relatives, who feared he wanted to be king.

Tacitus called him "without doubt the liberator of Germany". In the 1800s German nationalists made him a hero under the name Hermann and raised a giant statue to him, the Hermannsdenkmal.
sum: A chieftain of the Cherusci, a Germanic people, who in 9 CE destroyed three Roman legions at the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest.
